doc.brief: The `GtkFontButton` allows to open a font chooser dialog to change the font.
doc.md:
The `GtkFontButton` allows to open a font chooser dialog to change
the font.

It is suitable widget for selecting a font in a preference dialog.

# CSS nodes

```
fontbutton
╰── button.font
    ╰── [content]
```

`GtkFontButton` has a single CSS node with name fontbutton which
contains a button node with the .font style class.

activate.brief: Emitted to when the font button is activated.
activate.md:
Emitted to when the font button is activated.

The `::activate` signal on `GtkFontButton` is an action signal and
emitting it causes the button to present its dialog.

font-set.brief: Emitted when the user selects a font.
font-set.md:
Emitted when the user selects a font.

When handling this signal, use [`FontChooser.get_font()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontChooser#method:get_font)
to find out which font was just selected.

Note that this signal is only emitted when the user changes the font.
If you need to react to programmatic font changes as well, use
the notify::font signal.
